[Market commentary](https://www.blackrock.com/us/individual/insights/blackrock-investment-institute/weekly-commentary#market-commentary)[Asset class views](https://www.blackrock.com/us/individual/insights/blackrock-investment-institute/weekly-commentary#asset-class-views). ![Image 4: This chart shows that S&P 500 earnings growth is still being revised higher -- an abnormal path given that analysts usually revise their expectations down as the year progresses.](https://www.blackrock.com/blk-one01-c-assets/cache-1777884101000/images/media-bin/web/global/charts/chart-of-the-week-20260504.svg). U.S. earnings momentum is gathering steam as [mega forces](https://www.blackrock.com/corporate/insights/blackrock-investment-institute/publications/mega-forces/geopolitical-fragmentation) – big structural changes such as geopolitical fragmentation and AI – are increasingly driving investment outcomes. Another key reason for U.S. equity fortitude: [The AI mega force is strengthening](https://www.blackrock.com/corporate/literature/market-commentary/weekly-investment-commentary-en-us-20260420-a-supercharged-ai-mega-force.pdf). We favor [thematic opportunities](https://www.blackrock.com/corporate/literature/market-commentary/weekly-investment-commentary-en-us-20260330-mideast-shock-fuels-investing-themes.pdf) amid a fragmenting world in search of energy security: infrastructure and defense in Europe and beyond.
